unlisted_practices: Self-evolving examiner-reasoner framework for training medical LLMs
Controlled knowledge accumulation separating temporary exploratory knowledge from curated persistent knowledge
Evidence-grounded multi-turn reasoning with external knowledge tools

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks MedZERO, a new self-evolving agent architecture for open-ended medical reasoning, evaluating it purely on public medical reasoning datasets without testing organizational deployment practices or safety guardrails.
